ordered_operations: cast modal Abrade and deliberately counter the legal spell
attempt an illegal X=2 cast with one target and prove complete rollback
cast the legal X=2 spell with two targets and deliberately counter it
foretell Ravenform as a special action
cast Ravenform from exile on a later turn for one blue mana
preconditions: Abrade requires an explicit legal mode and target.
required_assertions: illegal X target count leaves the entire state unchanged
the legal X spell records x_value 2 and two generic mana in its cost
Ravenform’s later alternative casting payment is exactly one blue mana
no fabricated CASTING_ABORTED event is required for the rolled-back attempt

plain_english: Abrade requires an explicit legal mode and target and is legally cast before the test deliberately counters it.
A mismatched X target count is rejected atomically with no event or state mutation; a legal X=2 spell is then cast and deliberately countered for test cleanup.
Ravenform is foretold face down with the normal foretell special-action payment and is cast on a later turn for its one-blue alternative casting cost.
title: Modal, X, rollback, and foretell casting use the shared executor
